title: fix(cli)!: os validate refuses a field naming a sibling package's picklist without a declared dependency
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97hkDTw4QcCCcbBHrZv1dPd)_

Fixes #31832

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Narrowing: yes. Measured: on base `cc16008a` the door accepts a field naming a sibling package's list with no declared dependency (the new refusal pin is RED there, see Verification); on head it refuses it as `picklist-reference-unknown`. The runtime already refuses the same reference since E6 (#31731): the boot warns and serves no options, the post-seal install judge refuses. Narrowing face: `os validate` / `os build` exit 1 for a `packages[]` artifact whose field `picklist` is held only by packages outside the declaring package's declared dependency closure (plus `sys`), when that package declares no dependency outside the artifact. Two further refusals, both already refused by the boot (`INVALID_METADATA`, quoting the same sentence) and refused here whatever the outside dependencies: (a) a field whose package declares dependencies on two packages of the artifact that both declare the list (`ambiguous-in-closure`); (b) a `picklistExtensions` target two packages of the artifact declare (`ambiguous-in-environment`). Both were accepted on base. First-party count: 0 (no `examples/**` app and no platform package declares a picklist; E6 measured the same).
Skills-docs: none. No published skill teaches a field naming another package's picklist; `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` mentions picklist only for `fieldPatches`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate` / `os build` 现在按运行时的规则解析字段的 `picklist`：先找声明该字段的包自己的列表，再找它声明的依赖闭包（加 `sys`）。同一发布包里兄弟包的列表，如果没有声明依赖，会被拒绝，提示句与运行时一字不差，并给出要加的那一行 `dependencies`。
- 为什么改：E6 之后，运行时对这种引用会告警、字段没有选项、安装被拒；可作者期的门仍然放行，作者直到安装才发现。现在 `os validate` 当场说清楚。
- 风险与回滚：收窄。多包制品里依赖兄弟包列表却没声明依赖的字段，从“校验通过”变成“校验失败”；运行时早已拒绝它，所以只是提前报错。第一方计数 0。回滚即 revert 本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts` 的 `referenceResolver`（直接调用 `resolvePackageScopedHolders` + `packageResolutionClosure`，没有第二套闭包遍历）和 `refusedReferenceHint`；`picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts` 末尾新 describe（门的句子等于启动告警的句子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/picklist-references.test.ts src/utils/picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`，预期 53 passed；其中 “a field naming a sibling package's list (ADR-0150 D3)” 一组在 main 上是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前席位做 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 合同审查并告知 epic 席位）。

## What changes

1. **The door resolves a reference with the runtime's rule, not a copy of it.** `judgePicklistReferences` builds the holders of each list from the bodies that declare it (`packageScopedHolderSource`), and asks `resolvePackageScopedHolders` (`@objectstack/core`) with the closure from `packageResolutionClosure` (`@objectstack/metadata-core`), over a registry view of the artifact (each body answers `getPackage` for its own id). Those are the calls the registry's `picklistReferenceVerdict` makes, so no second closure walk exists. Both packages were already direct dependencies of `@objectstack/cli`.
2. **A field's `picklist` resolves from the package that declares the field**: own list, then the unique holder in its declared dependency closure plus `sys`, else R's refusal. A refusal is `picklist-reference-unknown` with R's message verbatim (it names every candidate package and says to declare the dependency), and a hint carrying the exact entry, for example `'com.example.core': '^1.0.0'` added to the `dependencies` of the declaring package, plus the consequence (no options, values refused). No new rule id, error code or export.
3. **The outside-dependency arm softens only what an outside package could fix.** When the declaring package also depends on a package the artifact does not carry, a name nothing here holds, or one held only outside the closure (`outside-closure`), is reported as `picklist-reference-unverified` (info, never gating), because that dependency could supply the list. Two holders one reference reaches (`ambiguous-in-closure`, `ambiguous-in-environment`) are refused even then: an outside package can add a holder, never remove one (contract review F1).
4. **A `picklistExtensions` entry's `extend` resolves with no caller** (epic-seat ruling X on the E6 card; the registry does the same): any single holder in the stack, so an extension of a sibling's list still needs no dependency (pinned as a CONTROL), and a target two packages hold is refused, naming both.
5. **A stack with no `packages[]` is unchanged**: it is one package, every list it declares is its own.
6. **`os explain picklist-reference-unverified` follows the rule** (`packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`, added to the surface by the seat's claim amendment 6735317750): its first paragraph now says how a field's `picklist` resolves (declaring package, declared dependencies transitively, plus `sys`; a sibling counts only when declared; an extension against the one package that holds the list; two holders refused), and its fix paragraph adds declaring the dependency.
7. **The closure notice is one short verdict line.** When the declaring package also has an outside dependency, the notice names the holders (`FIELD: 'LIST' is only in 'PKG', undeclared — not judged: 'DEP' may hold it`) instead of quoting R's whole sentence; pinned at most 200 characters with realistic package and field names, and its hint names the dependency to declare. The refusal keeps R's sentence verbatim.
8. The module header's ADR-0130 paragraph is rewritten to the ruled rule, citing ADR-0150 D3 and ruling 6729820123, worded after child A's ADR-0130 note in PR #31841. The text-face heading over the reference refusals now names the closure case too.

## Tests

- `picklist-references.test.ts`, new describe "a field naming a sibling package's list (ADR-0150 D3)", 12 cases: refused with R's sentence (`packageScopedRefusalMessage`) and the dependency hint; two undeclared sibling holders both named; reported, not refused, when the declaring package has an outside dependency (hint names the dependency); that notice at most 200 characters with realistic names; two declared sibling holders refused `ambiguous-in-closure`, with and without an outside dependency; an `objectExtensions` field judged from the extending package; CONTROL declared dependency; CONTROL transitive dependency; CONTROL own list; CONTROL `sys` list with no dependency; CONTROL sibling extension with no dependency; an extension target two packages hold refused `ambiguous-in-environment`, with and without an outside dependency.
- `picklist-references.boot-parity.test.ts`, new describe, 4 cases on a real kernel: the door's refusal message equals the boot's `findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences()` refusal for the same field; CONTROL with the dependency declared, the door accepts and the boot reports nothing; a two-holder field and a two-holder extension target, each refused by the door and by the boot (`INVALID_METADATA`, the boot's message quoting the door's sentence).
- **Forced test changes:** `picklistRefusalHeading` CONTROL pin (heading text now names the closure case; renamed from "keep the heading they always had"); the boot-parity file's #29898 describe docblock (it described the sibling allowance under ADR-0130). the first boot-parity describe's CONTROL stack now declares the core body's dependency on the app body, and asserts the door accepts the whole stack (before, it was a stack this door now refuses, passing only because it filtered to `picklist-residual-unreferenced`). No assertion of an existing case changed otherwise.

## Acceptance notes

- PR #31841 (child A, Tier H) adds a dated note to this file's module header saying the code still resolves against every body's picklists. #31841 landed first (8079fa9b), so this branch merged main (no conflicts) and deleted that note in `661fbd90`; the file is again the blob it was at `e32fe7b2`.
- File surface: `packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts`, its two test files, root `.changeset/31832-*.md`, and `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` (the `picklist-reference-unverified` entry's text only, claim amendment 6735317750). No test pin on that text moved: `rule-explanations.test.ts` and `packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` list the id only.

## Verification

<details><summary>RED on main, then green on head (e32fe7b2)</summary>

Head implementation swapped for base `cc16008a`'s blob (`931bc8f2`), tests from head, under the verify lock: 11 failed / 42 passed. Failing: every new refusal and notice pin (sibling refusal, two undeclared holders, outside-dependency notice, realistic-length notice, two declared holders, `objectExtensions` field, two-holder extension), the three refusal boot-parity pins, and the forced heading pin. Every new CONTROL passed on main. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Head: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 53 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored: blob equals HEAD 0e54d2bc, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- **Closure back to whole-stack resolution** (`closureOf` returns every artifact package): 5 failed / 48 passed — sibling refusal, outside-dependency notice, realistic-length notice, `objectExtensions` field, boot-parity sentence. The two-holder pins stay green in the expected direction: with every package reachable they are still refused as ambiguous.
- **F1: an outside dependency softens every refusal again** (the refuse branch tests only `judged.outside.length === 0`): 2 failed / 51 passed — two declared holders with an outside dependency, two-holder extension with an outside dependency.
- **F2: a two-holder verdict passes, as on base** (a non-`outside-closure` refusal skipped like a resolution): 4 failed / 49 passed — both two-holder unit pins and both two-holder boot-parity pins.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates on head e32fe7b2, rerun on 661fbd90</summary>

- After merging main (`ac8fede8`) and deleting the note, on `661fbd90`: closure build, the two picklist suites (53 passed), cli typecheck and cli unit (406 files, 5807 tests) exit 0; the same 69 derived families all exit 0, `--ran` 69/69, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 69 families derived for the 5 changed paths. All 69 ran on `e32fe7b2`, every one exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. (Earlier: `check-adr-0087-registration` was red on `fcf3a4b9` until `8f820082` added the changeset's `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker; 63/63 green on `8f820082`, 69/69 on `688a9602`.)
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, `test` (197 files, 8365 tests) and `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` and `typecheck` (tsc plus `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit`: 406 files, 5807 tests passed. The integration tier is declared to CI (no spawn entry or integration file touched).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` over the changed source files: exit 0 (neither package has a `lint` script).
- Full turbo build of `packages/**` (on `fcf3a4b9`): exit 0.
- Full dogfood battery on `e32fe7b2`: exit 0; 441 files passed, 3 skipped; 3662 tests passed, 42 skipped; no failures.
</details>
